_note: German (du, lower case; German capitalisation; „…“ for quotation marks), not yet reviewed by a German speaker. The glossary is in docs/translating.md. The Bibles window, the sheet asking what a Bible file is, the Bible view's Options panel, installing, downloading and reading Bibles, and their errors; a Bible named in a sentence takes the head noun Bibel („Die Bibel {bible} …“; not Übersetzung, since original-language texts are offered too), and the captions the English writes in capitals in the code (INSTALLED, PREVIEW) stay in capitals.
